newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open up 0.40 to 0.70 cent.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open up 0.40 to 0.70 cent.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open up 0.40 to 0.70 cent Thursday as LME three months set a fresh one-year high at $2,530 per tonne and the London backwardation flared overnight.
LME stocks fell 975 tonnes Thursday to 139,000 tonnes.
COMEX stocks on Wednesday fell 175 short tons to 39,373 short tons.
On ACCESS, COMEX July copper traded 119.10 to 117.80 cents a lb against Wednesday's close of 118.20 cents.
The LME backwardation was $87/$92, some $10 to $15 above Wednesday's levels, and down from the overnight high of about $100.
